d: Deep crimson, spiky hair flows upward from the crown, paired with narrow, focused amber eyes. The face possesses a mature, stern expression on a muscular, humanoid-canine build. The outfit consists of a golden-yellow shoulder wrap, a dark grey waist-cloth with gold trim, and a brown utility pouch, complemented by a large rectangular grey shield strapped to the back. Visible non-human traits include a canine snout, pointed ears, and two black curved horns protruding from the head. BODY COLOR: Brown LEGS: Digitigrade, ending in wide paws with dark claws.
